items.text: Sessions of 3 to 5 minutes, several times a day.
Chickpea-sized rewards taken from the daily ration. A special reward (boiled chicken) only for come.
Everyone uses the same cue words.
If something does not work, lower the difficulty.
Three meals a day until 4-6 months; 16-18 hours of sleep.
Let her use her nose: hide a few rewards in the grass and let her find them.
After activity comes rest: out, train, eat, sleep.
Play is fine, but repeated chasing (ball, sticks) is not the center of her day; balance it with exploring and calm.
Watching the fence or the road is not her job: do not let her spend hours guarding.
